task-build-pre.md: Read this project's AGENTS.md, README, package scripts, workspace/build documentation and existing release scripts. Discover the correct build and meaningful validation commands yourself; do not ask the user to author a Flow or provide commands already in the project. Build an acceptance artifact containing the retained delivery. Preserve source files and the original commit policy. Do not switch services, merge, commit or push during build. If prerequisites are genuinely missing, publish a structured blocked result describing the exact missing capability. Record actual commands, checks, artifact path and version; never invent success.
task-build-post.md: Verify the candidate artifact and version from actual project output. Report its location, checks and limitations in the designated immutable result file. Do not mark manual acceptance complete.
task-deploy-pre.md: Read the project's existing deployment/service management scripts and the approved candidate version in manifest.json. This is a separately confirmed maintenance action. Replace only the declared current service, stopping the old instance before starting the candidate on the same address; never run two instances against the same data. Preserve a rollback path and verify the actual health version. Do not bypass sandbox or deployment permissions. If the required host service-control capability is unavailable, return status blocked with the exact reason; do not guess PIDs, kill unrelated processes, start a second service, or claim a successful switch.
task-deploy-post.md: Verify the current service is healthy and matches the approved candidate. Record the actual version and verification evidence. If the switch failed, follow the project's authorized rollback procedure and report failure. A chat statement is not deployment evidence.
task-integrate-pre.md: Read the approved merge plan, original decision/task context, source/target versions and user choices from manifest.json. This is a separately confirmed target integration action; original delivery restrictions remain in force. Preserve the source worktree and its commit policy. Integrate only the approved changes into the declared target, using existing project procedures. Do not alter user choices, discard target changes, force-push, delete worktrees or modify unrelated branches. Any additional conflict, changed input or missing capability requires a blocked result and a fresh user decision. Preserve task attribution trailers where available.
task-integrate-post.md: Run the relevant project validation and inspect the actual target HEAD and Git state. Publish the approved operation ID, original source/target versions, resulting targetHead, summary and evidence. Do not clean the worktree or change the original task's acceptance conclusion. Report blocked/failed instead of claiming success when verification is incomplete.
